full_judgment: 6. The learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the learned court of appeal below during disposal of the appeal committed illegality and that the impugned judgment and decree is not a proper judgment and decree of reversal. The learned Advocate further submits that the appointment of the defendant-petitioner is legal and on compliance of the Rules of Non-Government Institution Instruction Manual issued from the ministry of education the appointment was completed. The learned Advocate also submits that the plaintiff-opposite party has no locus standi to institute the original suit under section 42 of the Specific Relief Act and secondly the plaintiff before institution of the suit without exhausting the proper forum to seek redress of his grievances filed the original suit and as a result of which the learned trial court was quite justified to reject the plaint under Order VII, rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure. The learned Advocate lastly submits that no fruitful result can be given from a decree by a civil court in the instant nature of suit and the learned appellate court without proper appreciation of law decided the merit of the appeal illegally which deserve interference of this court.
